titles.en: The Beach and a Better Year
titles.ko: 해변의 위기와 더 나은 한 해

continuity.opening: On the beach, Pinocchio discovers that his classmates invented the Shark rumour.
continuity.closing: After a year of better choices, Pinocchio is promised humanity, but Lamp-Wick is waiting with one last temptation.
continuity.next: On the eve of becoming human, Pinocchio hears about a country where nobody studies or works.

learningObjective: Retell conflict and rescue by separating blame from responsibility and showing how change is proven over time.

beats.title: The False Rumour
beats.purpose: Reveal the classmates’ deception and push Pinocchio from restraint towards anger.

beats.title: A Battle of Books
beats.purpose: Turn a comic quarrel into real harm without celebrating the violence.

beats.title: Wrongly Accused
beats.purpose: Separate Pinocchio’s responsibility for fighting from blame for Eugene’s injury.

beats.title: Saving Alidoro
beats.purpose: Make Pinocchio risk freedom to rescue the dog pursuing him.

beats.title: The Green Fisherman
beats.purpose: Place Pinocchio in absurd but genuine danger after his escape.

beats.title: A Rescue Repaid
beats.purpose: Complete the reciprocal rescue and return responsibility to Pinocchio.

beats.title: The Slow Door
beats.purpose: Use impatience and comic punishment to expose a habit that still needs work.

beats.title: A Better Year
beats.purpose: Demonstrate lasting change through repeated effort before the next temptation arrives.
